## Current Focus

I am focused on work that turns complex football questions into practical decision-support tools: scouting, recruitment, performance analysis, coaching workflows, and academy evaluation. My edge is the combination of senior production ML experience, credible football analytics project work, and the ability to translate research into systems and visuals that practitioners can actually use.

## Highlights

- Senior Data Scientist II at CrowdStrike, building production machine learning and applied AI systems for high-scale Falcon product environments.
- Data science lead for Falcon Next-Gen SIEM's first ML-powered product feature, with ownership across model development, evaluation, explainability, monitoring design, and delivery.
- Pitch to the Pros 3 finalist for "Was the Best Pass Really Playable?", a SkillCorner tracking/event-data project adding execution context to pass value.
- Football analytics work across off-ball support creation, StatsBomb event-data modelling, and academy productivity analysis.
- Public patent applications and technical articles in applied machine learning, cybersecurity research, anomaly detection, and source-code classification.
